summary: Backend testing for Package Services CRUD + Seed (iteration 39). 16 pytest tests covering list/create/update/delete/seed across Premium, Business, Business+ packages with admin auth (settings@marsol.az). All tests passed (16/16). One MINOR bug uncovered: GET /api/settings/packages/{id}/services returns 404 instead of [] when a package exists but has no services field (e.g. Sponsor pre-seed) due to a MongoDB projection quirk.

minor.issue: Returns 404 'Paket tapılmadı' when the package document exists but has no `services` field (e.g., Sponsor before any seed). Root cause: projection `{"_id": 0, "services": 1}` makes MongoDB return `{}` for such docs, and `if not pkg` treats the empty dict as falsy. Should return an empty list [] instead. Fix: query without projection or check existence first (e.g. `await db.packages.find_one({"id": package_id}, {"_id": 0})` then `services = pkg.get('services') or []`).

action_items: Fix GET /api/settings/packages/{id}/services to return [] (not 404) when package exists but has no `services` key. Suggested fix in server.py ~line 2914: drop the `services: 1` projection or do existence check first.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py ~2914: list_package_services uses MongoDB projection {'_id': 0, 'services': 1} which collapses to {} for documents lacking `services`, causing false 404. Use plain `{'_id': 0}` projection or two-step (existence check then read).

server.py ~2934: `int(data.get('sort_order') if data.get('sort_order') is not None else len(services))` will raise 500 (uncaught ValueError) if a non-numeric string is sent for sort_order on POST. update_package_service handles this gracefully via try/except; create should too.
server.py ~2954: PUT update casts name/description/value via `str(...).strip()` even when the field is absent-but-None vs explicitly null. Acceptable for now; partial updates work as expected.

Seed endpoint (server.py ~2980) is idempotent and replaces the entire services array (good), but it uses fresh UUIDs each run, so any service IDs cached on the client become stale after re-seeding. Consider preserving IDs by name or warning consumers.
seed_data_creation: Seed endpoint POST /api/settings/packages/services/seed invoked once per session via pytest fixture. It creates the 4 default packages if missing, then writes 19 services into Premium/Business/Business Plus. Sponsor remains untouched (no services field). All TEST_-prefixed services created during CRUD tests were deleted in their test/finally blocks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration39_package_services.py is reusable as regression. It seeds once per session (session-scope fixture). All assertions verified against requirements: catalog_size=19, B2B values 15/20/30, Video Müsahibə Premium excluded, Facebook Business+ included, Sponsor skipped from seed summary. Empty-name validation returns 400. Partial updates work. Auth requires Bearer token (admin). One minor 404-vs-[] bug surfaced in GET when package has no services key — currently the test tolerates this; once main agent fixes, tighten the assertion in test_seed_skips_sponsor.
rca of the issue: Sponsor 404 bug RCA — Reproduction: 1) Login as settings@marsol.az, 2) GET /api/settings/packages → confirm Sponsor package exists with id S, 3) GET /api/settings/packages/S/services → 404. Root cause: server.py:2914 uses `db.packages.find_one({'id': pid}, {'_id': 0, 'services': 1})`; for Sponsor the document has no `services` key, so MongoDB returns `{}` (after _id removed). The check `if not pkg` is True for empty dict and triggers 404. Mitigation: change the projection to `{'_id': 0}` (or `{'_id': 0, 'id': 1, 'services': 1}`) so the existence check is reliable, then `services = pkg.get('services') or []` already handles missing field.
